nodes.name: Set Ticket ID
nodes.notes: Change 'PROJ-123' to the real Jira ticket ID you want to test, or replace this node with a Form/Webhook trigger to pass it in dynamically.

nodes.name: Generate Test Cases (Claude)
nodes.notes: Header auth credential should set header name 'x-api-key' with your Anthropic API key as the value.

parameters.jsCode: const response = $input.first().json; const testCases = response.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text; return [{ json: { testCases } }]

nodes.name: Post Comment to Jira
nodes.notes: Optional: instead of posting back to Jira, you could swap this for a Google Sheets, Slack, or Email node.
